title: The decisions about the whole move here from ocoeco
note: Decided in ocoeco while there was no place for them: the room, the fulldome, many observatories, places lenses and acts, the names of places, a place says what it gathers. They hold between the stars, so they belong to the constellation. To move with their research and words, links kept. Done 2026-11-13: seven decisions moved here from ocoeco by ocoeco move, every link kept true - the room, the fulldome, many observatories, places lenses and acts, the names of places, the two places made, argenv for every tool. What they rest on (research, sources) stays in ocoeco and is pointed at there.

title: Every command line of the commons declared with argenv
note: Decided 2026-11-11 and carried out for three of eight (checked 2026-11-13): snapall, lab-agent and oco-agent are declared with argenv; ocoeco, tad, the engine (oco), devlab and tone are not. What each gains: help, completions and man pages made from the one declaration, and one way of reading arguments and the environment in every program.
